title: Learning Generative Dynamics with Soft Path-Law Constraints: A McKean-Vlasov FBSDE Approach
abstract: arXiv:2605.08928v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce a unified framework for learning stochastic dynamics from distributional observations and discretely observed trajectories. The key contribution is to combine soft law constraints, which regularize fitting to empirical distributions, with path-dependent supervision, which captures temporal structure that marginal distributions alone cannot identify. We formulate the problem as a discrete path-dependent McKean-Vlasov control problem, penalizing endpoint, intermediate marginal, and joint sampled-path laws within a single objective. Its optimality system takes the form of a McKean-Vlasov forward-backward stochastic differential equation (FBSDE), in which the marginal terms act continuously in time while the path-law term instead induces conditional adjoint jumps at the observation dates. translated_title: 基于软路径律约束的学习生成动力学：一种McKean-Vlasov正倒向随机微分方程方法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个从分布观测和离散观测轨迹中学习随机动力学的统一框架。其关键贡献是将软分布律约束（用于对经验分布拟合进行正则化）与路径依赖监督（用于捕捉仅凭边际分布无法识别的时间结构）相结合。我们将该问题表述为一个离散路径依赖的McKean-Vlasov控制问题，在单一目标函数中对终端点分布、中间边际分布以及联合采样路径分布施加惩罚。该问题的最优性系统呈现为McKean-Vlasov正倒向随机微分方程的形式，其中边际项随时间连续作用，而路径律项则在观测时刻引发条件伴随跳。我们针对二次控制代价和常数扩散系数的情形推导了简化的FBSDE，并对基于最大均值差的惩罚系统建立了局部适定性……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一个统一框架，将软分布律约束与路径依赖监督相结合，把从分布观测和离散轨迹学习随机动力学的问题表述为离散路径依赖的McKean-Vlasov控制问题，其最优性系统为McKean-Vlasov正倒向随机微分方程（FBSDE）。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified framework combining soft law constraints with path-dependent supervision, formulating the learning of stochastic dynamics from distributional observations and discretely observed trajectories as a discrete path-dependent McKean-Vlasov control problem whose optimality system takes the form of a McKean-Vlasov FBSDE.
